purpose: Form CHG-3 is the certificate of modification of charge issued by the Registrar when particulars of modification of charge are registered under section 79.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Register the particulars of modification of charge under section 79.
The Registrar issues the certificate of modification of charge in Form No. CHG-3.
checklist: Ensure particulars of modification of charge are ready for registration under section 79.
watch: The certificate issued by the Registrar is conclusive evidence of compliance with Chapter VI of the Act and the rules.
